payingUser: A recreational drone pilot who wants a quick, local launch-window decision before travelling to a flying spot.
paidUnit: A one-time unlock of seven-day, altitude-aware launch windows, saved flight profiles, reminders, and shareable go/no-go briefs.
momentOfPayment: After the pilot compares today's free launch window with the next suitable window and requests the seven-day plan or a saved-profile alert.
distinctnessSentence: SkyWindow turns free weather data into named altitude-aware launch windows with every failed threshold shown, rather than selling a forecast horizon behind a subscription or making the pilot interpret separate weather cards.
day1RevenuePath: The free view provides the current-day result; the first dollar arrives when a pilot taps the seven-day window plan or a saved-profile alert and buys the one-time unlock.
assumptionsUnverified: That pilots will pay a one-time 4.99 dollar price for seven-day planning rather than retain a free competitor with in-app purchases.
That the threshold explanation and non-subscription price are enough of a wedge against the 1M-plus-install incumbents.
That Open-Meteo's forecast coverage and update cadence are adequate for the pilot's chosen launch location.
